title: Court observation
description: One hearing observed by a court watch volunteer. This is the core record of the Courtnotes data standard, version 1. Released under CC0 1.0: use it in any tool, for any purpose.

id.description: Globally unique id generated on the observer's device when the hearing starts.

shift_id.description: The shift (court-watch-shift record) during which this hearing was observed.

case_number.description: Docket or case number, if the program records it. Public court records, but consider removing them from published datasets.

ended_at.description: When the next case was called or the hearing otherwise ended.

duration_seconds.description: Length of the hearing as measured by the observer's timer. Can differ from `ended_at - started_at` if the timer was paused.

bail.description: Money bail set at this hearing. Present only when `release_decision` is `bail_set`.

amount.description: Total bail amount set by the judge, in major currency units (dollars, not cents).

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Defaults to USD when absent.

prosecution_request.description: Amount the prosecution asked for, if stated.

release_conditions.description: Non-monetary conditions of release, if any were imposed.

defendant.description: What the observer could see about the defendant. Every field is optional, and perceived characteristics are the observer's perception only. Never record names.

in_custody.description: Whether the defendant was in custody (e.g. brought from jail) at the hearing.

judge_remarks.description: Notable words from the bench, as close to verbatim as possible.

recorded_at.description: When the record was first created on the device.

updated_at.description: When the record was last changed. Used for last-writer-wins sync.
